title: Pip / Memory pebble
name: 记忆卵石
idea: A SINGLE asymmetric rounded triangular pebble creature, leaning gently forward, one continuous convex domed top with NO notch and NO paired lobes. A small ivory horizontal recessed capsule face with two dark pupils, subtly offset toward the right, and one very short small foot-like base. A tiny butter-yellow circular memory bead nests inside a small inward side recess at the LOWER RIGHT edge, not on top. Whole-body silhouette like a soft river stone tilted inquisitively, proportions width:height about 1:1.25. Intelligent little mobile companion. Extremely simple silhouette, premium sculptural flat logo. Character movement through leaning, compressing and pupil motion. No ears, no tail, no symmetry of two bulges.

title: Luma / Memory lantern
name: 口袋灯灵
idea: A tiny living lantern AI creature, with a SINGLE upright softly tapered capsule body, one smooth continuous rounded top, broad flat rounded base and short integrated feet. Deep ink-green outer shell with a warm butter-yellow soft rectangular face window occupying upper middle, two tiny green eyes. A distinctive short diagonal cut on ONE upper corner creates an ownable asymmetric silhouette but is NOT a notch or paired lobe. Imagine a pocket-sized friendly keeper of your memories with understated Japanese industrial-design refinement, not a conventional box robot. No handle, no antenna, no ears, no external light rays on main logo, no extra buttons. Primary overall form taller than wide approximately 1.3:1. Minimal 2 colors.

title: Kip / Memory bird
name: 记忆小鸟
idea: An original ultra-minimal abstract tiny bird-shaped digital familiar: ONE continuous round head flowing into a single teardrop body, a very short pointed beak extending to the right, two tiny ivory eyes placed close together on the front-right face so it is clearly a three-quarter view, one simple butter-yellow wing shape integrated within deep evergreen body, two very short rounded feet. No owl ear tufts, no two-lobe top, no fluffy feather detail, no wide smile, no resemblance to famous language-app owl. Compact sculptural silhouette with a subtle forward lean, thoughtful and quietly curious, like a little bird that collects and brings back memories. Gold-ratio-inspired relationship between round head mass and tapered body, no decorative geometry.

title: Nori / Memory sprout
name: 记忆芽
idea: An original living memory seed mascot with a SINGLE smooth upright rounded egg/bean body in deep evergreen, ivory two tiny oval eyes on the upper third, a SINGLE small asymmetric butter-yellow leaf emerging diagonally from the upper LEFT side on a short integrated stem, two tiny integrated rounded feet. No other limbs, no mouth, no nose, no ears, no tail, no center split or notch anywhere on body. Slightly tilted egg-shaped body with one gently flattened side creates character. The single leaf acts as an expressive memory signal and changes tilt with emotion. Mature elegant character logo, not a cartoon vegetable or fruit. Simple precise circular/elliptical curves; body and leaf proportions approximately 1.618 hierarchy.
